title: Jesus Before Pilate: What Is Truth?
reflectionText: Pilate asked, "What is truth?" Then he went outside and declared that he found no basis for a charge against Jesus. He recognized innocence, but the decision before him remained. What happens when the truth you recognize becomes costly?
